name: Horitomo (Kazuaki Kitamura)
headline: Master of Traditional Japanese Irezumi & Creator of Monmon Cats
bio: Kazuaki Kitamura (Horitomo) is a globally acclaimed practitioner of traditional Japanese tattooing with over three decades of immersion in Tebori (hand-carving) and machine work. An alumnus of Tokyo and Yokohama studios, Horitomo is celebrated both for reverent, historically rigorous bodysuits and for creating 'Monmon Cats'—a worldwide art phenomenon honoring cat folklore draped in classic Horimono motifs.
